cite_runs: [Curtis V.; December 5; United States District Court for the District of the Virgin Islands; “AGF Marine Aviation & Transp. v. Cassin, 2007 U.S. Dist. LEXIS 90808,” accessible on Lexus]
body: The Court inadvertently used the word "his" when
reference is consistent with the undisputed facts

in this case, which indicate that Cassin completed an application for the insurance policy and submitted it to his agent, Theodore Tunick & Company ("Tunick"). Tunick, in turn, submitted the application to AGF's underwriting agent, TL Dallas. (See Pl.'s Mem. of Law in Supp. of Mot. for Summ. J. 5.)
